faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Questions? Answered.
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before you start selling.
faq.q1: How much does Yerevan Digital cost?
faq.a1: Getting started is completely free — there are no monthly fees. You only pay a small commission when you make a sale.
faq.q2: Do I need any technical skills?
faq.a2: Not at all. If you can fill out a form, you can launch a store. Most sellers are live in under two minutes.
faq.a3: Accept Idram and Armenian bank transfers out of the box. Payments go directly to you.
faq.q4: Can my store be in more than one language?
faq.a4: Yes. Your storefront speaks Armenian, English, and Russian, and you manage your products in each language.
faq.q5: Can I change my store's design later?
faq.a5: Anytime. Switch templates and adjust colors, fonts, and your logo with a single click — no redesign needed.
faq.q6: Is there a contract or commitment?
faq.a6: No lock-in. Start for free and upgrade only if and when your business needs it.
